_comment: troute v2 A/B: cost-comparison route choice. troute (v1) ON in BOTH arms — validated; the lever is troute2 (compose terrain plan even when an interior route exists, adopt if cheaper by BOT_TROUTE_ADOPT_FACTOR). 4v4 continuous isengard, defaults env. Metrics, split at '$nav troute2 on|off' echoes: (1) 'v2 ADOPT' lines (terrain-vs-interior costs logged) + 'troute complete' (plans finishing after crossing); (2) end-to-end: PICKS/CAPS — v2 is the isengard carrier/attacker unlock candidate (valley route vs corkscrew); (3) room-36 corkscrew traffic (dances/stucks) should DROP in ON blocks if bots choose the valley; (4) monotone stalls (plan quality) + outdoor stucks (valley exposure cost).
